tool_args.rationale: The short-window pilot leaves the slow timescale and long-horizon behavior ambiguous. The slow-horizon discriminating probe directly addresses that ambiguity and is recommended by the retrieved sink-coupled mechanism note.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations cannot reliably identify both fast and slow dynamics or support extrapolation to H = 23.2.
Fine short-horizon measurements are less directly informative about slow adaptation and long-horizon reversal.

considered_alternatives.option: Dual-horizon reversal or periodic oscillation models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot does not distinguish these mechanisms from sink-coupled adaptation at the target horizon.
